source_name: Carry-roll-duration scenario on iShares Global Aggregate EUR Hedged characteristics
methodology: scenario, not a published CMA. carry=YTM 4.00%, roll_down=0.15pp assumption, credit_loss=0.10pp, TER=0.10%, hedge_effect=€STR(2.19)-SOFR(3.62)=-1.43pp, duration=6.05. 2026 conservative = +100bp yield and +20bp extra credit; optimistic = -50bp yield. Later years earn the new carry with no further duration hit. YTM is local-currency portfolio yield, so EUR-hedged expected return subtracts the USD-EUR hedge cost.

source_name: Scenario around World Bank CMO spot outlook plus roll, SOFR collateral, TER and USD/EUR
methodology: scenario for an unhedged EUR investor in a BCOM-style TR ETC. Not a conversion of Pink Sheet spots into futures TR.
